capabilities: Filter editor lines with a JavaScript regex
Edit the visible lines directly with edits saved to the note
Toggle the filter via command palette or hotkey
Save custom filters with individually assigned hotkeys
Insert relative date variables like {{date:YYYY-MM-DD}} in filters
disambiguation: Not a search tool; it hides non-matching lines in the editor view itself and never alters the underlying note content.
extras: README notes a known limitation with negative lookaheads in regex; features child-indent handling, empty-line hiding, and copy-visible-only behavior as settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to temporarily hide non-matching lines in the editor so you can focus on or edit just the lines you care about.

relations.evidence: the inspiration for saveable individual filters in your Advanced Cursors plugin

summary: Regex-based editor filter that hides all lines of the active note except those matching a user-supplied regular expression, while keeping edits live.
